tasks.title: Create reusable TimelineVisualization component for temporal datasets
tasks.description: US-200: Extract and generalize the timeline visualization from LanguageTimelineView into a reusable client/src/components/visualizations/shared/TimelineVisualization.tsx. Accept generic typed data with: id, label, start_year, end_year, category, metadata. Support horizontal and vertical orientations, zoom, pan, era markers, and color-by-category. Reuse for: language evolution timelines, civilization timelines, empire rise/fall, archaeological culture periods, literary tradition periods, music tradition eras, migration events.

tasks.title: Create reusable NetworkGraph component for relational datasets
tasks.description: US-201: Extract and generalize from LanguageNetworkView into client/src/components/visualizations/shared/NetworkGraph.tsx. Accept generic nodes (id, label, category, size, metadata) and edges (source, target, type, weight, metadata). Support: force-directed layout, hierarchical layout, radial layout, node clustering, edge bundling, zoom/pan, tooltips, click-to-expand. Reuse for: language family networks, deity pantheon graphs, trade networks, cultural influence networks, sound change chains, kinship system diagrams.

tasks.title: Create reusable TreeVisualization component for hierarchical datasets
tasks.description: US-202: Extract and generalize from LanguageTreeView into client/src/components/visualizations/shared/TreeVisualization.tsx. Accept generic tree data with: id, label, parent_id, children, metadata. Support: vertical/horizontal/radial layouts, collapsible nodes, search/highlight, zoom, breadcrumb navigation. Reuse for: language family trees, writing system descent, script evolution, cultural lineage trees, haplogroup trees, architectural style evolution, deity genealogies.

tasks.title: Create reusable ComparisonTable component for side-by-side analysis
tasks.description: US-203: Build client/src/components/visualizations/shared/ComparisonTable.tsx for comparing entities side by side. Accept: array of entity objects, column definitions with render functions, highlight-differences mode. Support: 2-6 entity comparison, sticky headers, sortable columns, expandable row groups, color-coded differences, export to CSV. Reuse for: language comparison (phonology, grammar, vocabulary), civilization comparison, deity equivalents, cuisine comparison, musical tradition comparison.

tasks.title: Create reusable SankeyFlow component for flow/influence datasets
tasks.description: US-204: Extract and generalize from SankeyDiagramVisualization into client/src/components/visualizations/shared/SankeyFlow.tsx. Accept: source/target flow data with magnitudes. Support: horizontal/vertical orientation, node reordering, link highlighting on hover, filtering by flow type, animated flow particles. Reuse for: language contact borrowings, trade good flows, migration flows, cultural influence propagation, ingredient origin diffusion, religious expansion pathways.

tasks.title: Create reusable ChordDiagram component for mutual relationship datasets
tasks.description: US-205: Extract and generalize from ChordDiagramVisualization into client/src/components/visualizations/shared/ChordDiagram.tsx. Accept: symmetric relationship matrix with labels and categories. Support: arc highlighting, tooltip with relationship details, category-based coloring, filter by minimum connection strength. Reuse for: language mutual intelligibility, trade partner networks, cultural exchange, deity equivalences across cultures, musical influence patterns.

tasks.title: Create reusable HeatmapGrid component for matrix datasets
tasks.description: US-206: Build client/src/components/visualizations/shared/HeatmapGrid.tsx for displaying feature-by-entity matrices. Accept: row labels, column labels, cell values (numeric or categorical), color scale config. Support: row/column sorting (alphabetical, hierarchical clustering), zoom on cell hover, row/column highlighting, value tooltips, dendrograms. Reuse for: linguistic distance matrices, grammar feature comparison across languages, phoneme inventory comparison, WALS feature maps, genetic-linguistic correlation matrices.

tasks.title: Create reusable GeoDistributionMap component for any mappable dataset
tasks.description: US-207: Build client/src/components/visualizations/shared/GeoDistributionMap.tsx as a lightweight, embeddable map component for use within panels and detail views (separate from the full EnhancedLanguageMapView). Accept: array of {lat, lng, label, value, category} points or {polygon, label, value, category} regions. Support: auto-zoom to bounds, choropleth coloring, point clustering, simple time slider, legend. Reuse for: embedding mini-maps in any panel showing geographic distribution of that panel's data.

tasks.title: Create reusable ParallelCoordinates component for multi-dimensional comparison
tasks.description: US-208: Build client/src/components/visualizations/shared/ParallelCoordinates.tsx for comparing entities across multiple numeric/ordinal dimensions. Accept: array of entities with named numeric fields, axis configurations. Support: axis reordering via drag, brush filtering on any axis, line highlighting, color by category. Reuse for: comparing languages across multiple typological features, comparing civilizations across multiple metrics, cross-domain correlation exploration.

tasks.title: Create unified VisualizationContainer wrapper with shared controls
tasks.description: US-209: Build client/src/components/visualizations/shared/VisualizationContainer.tsx that wraps any visualization with consistent controls: title bar, fullscreen toggle, export menu (PNG/SVG/CSV), info tooltip explaining the visualization, resize handle, loading/error states. Standardize all existing and new visualizations to use this container for a unified look and feel.

Clickable bars navigate to civilization detail.

Edges typed (familial, equivalent, shared-motif).

Show script descent: Proto-Sinaitic → Phoenician → Greek → Latin/Cyrillic/Coptic, and Brahmi → Devanagari/Thai/Tibetan/etc. Include sample glyphs at each node. Temporal positioning on the tree. Clickable nodes show writing system detail.

tasks.title: Create MusicalTraditionExplorer using reusable NetworkGraph and GeoDistributionMap

tasks.title: Create CuisineComparisonView using reusable ComparisonTable and SankeyFlow

tasks.title: Create LinguisticTypologyHeatmap using reusable HeatmapGrid
